Mesh counts

Source: R/lari.R
lari_counts.Rd

Vertex counts by origin, face and segment counts, and the report from the last refinement: bad triangles still failing a criterion, and of those how many have a short edge (below the floor), touch a sharp constrained corner, or have their circumcentre outside the meshed domain; inserted vertices, whether the max_steiner budget stopped it, and stalled (the mesher stopped making progress; should be 0).

Usage

lari_counts(m)

Arguments

m

a mesh from lari_new()

Value

a list

Examples

## a square with a square hole: two closed rings of segments
x <- c(0, 1, 1, 0, 0.25, 0.75, 0.75, 0.25)
y <- c(0, 0, 1, 1, 0.25, 0.25, 0.75, 0.75)
m <- lari_new(x, y, s0 = 1:8, s1 = c(2, 3, 4, 1, 6, 7, 8, 5))
lari_counts(m)
#> $input
#> [1] 8
#> 
#> $crossing
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $steiner
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $faces
#> [1] 10
#> 
#> $segments
#> [1] 8
#> 
#> $edges
#> [1] 8
#> 
#> $refined
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $mesher_alive
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $min_edge_length
#> [1] NA
#> 
#> $unrefined
#>                 bad          shortEdges    sharpFixedCorner circumcenterOutside 
#>                   0                   0                   0                   0 
#>            inserted           budgetHit             stalled 
#>                   0                   0                   0 
#> 
lari_refine(m, max_area = 0.01, min_angle = 25)
lari_counts(m)
#> $input
#> [1] 8
#> 
#> $crossing
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $steiner
#> [1] 81
#> 
#> $faces
#> [1] 144
#> 
#> $segments
#> [1] 8
#> 
#> $edges
#> [1] 48
#> 
#> $refined
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $mesher_alive
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $min_edge_length
#> [1] 0.025
#> 
#> $unrefined
#>                 bad          shortEdges    sharpFixedCorner circumcenterOutside 
#>                   0                   0                   0                   0 
#>            inserted           budgetHit             stalled 
#>                  81                   0                   0 
#>
